title: Education City Stadium
visualBrief: Specific Education City Stadium: own rounded mapped body and rounded rectangular aperture, closed folded silver diamond shell with staggered facet rows/four recessed zigzag ventilation strips/lower scalloped hem and recessed glazed/service entries/individual supports and concourse decks, connected rolled pale metallic roof with large diamond tone approximations/renderable underside/deep inner aperture truss/radial lattice, three green/white seating bands/two closed dark inter-tier belts/open sunken neutral football floor and supported end displays/lights/marks/goals. Six existing shared concrete/paint/beadblasted-stainless/expanded-diamond/window-grid/canvas graphs. No unique texture atlas, copied seat logos/event art, whole campus/golf landscape slab, hidden furnished rooms or active cooling simulation.
